observations: The release contains the ChatGPT.app payload profile only.
The Browser Use renderer availability chunk is absent; the Linux node_repl shim and main-process gates are the available evidence.
The annotation-editor and composer renderer chunks required by the experimental App Snapshot patch are absent.

coreRebuild.evidence: The application package, Electron metadata, and native-module rebuild inputs were inspected for this release.

mobilePairing.evidence: The upstream pairing surface is exposed, but account enrollment remains release-dependent.

browserUse.evidence: Availability can resolve on Linux, but an active Browser Use session has not completed an action end to end.

appSnapshot.evidence: Required experimental renderer chunks are absent, so the patch is intentionally not applied.

chromeControl.evidence: The Google Chrome native-host groundwork is present, but Chrome runtime control has not been verified.

backgroundPresence.evidence: Reliable Linux tray and background presence are not part of this release.
